verdict.rationale: Anthropic publishes a dedicated rate-limits page documenting RPM/TPM limits, tier scaling, and enforcement semantics (e.g., 60 RPM enforced as 1 req/sec), viewable per-account, plus a token-counting endpoint to preemptively manage limits. Missing for 10: an explicit documented sample of the 429 response body/headers format and independent hands-on confirmation of tier thresholds matching docs.
